findings.body: Once this logger is registered with Nest, `Logger.fatal(...)` silently produces no output because `JsonLogger` has no `fatal` method. Nest delegates through an optional call to the custom logger's method ([Nest implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nestjs/nest/master/packages/common/services/logger.service.ts)). This loses precisely the unrecoverable-failure records required by `src/forge/standards.md:166`. Add a `fatal` method that writes the corresponding level and cover it in the logger regression test, which currently exercises only `log`.
findings.title: Implement fatal logging in the replacement logger
